facts.title: hazard report - thermal exposure at SG-8000

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ARC_FLASH_PPE_AND_BOUNDARY: the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the arc flash boundary and protective equipment on SG-8000 and TX-8001 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on SG-8000 and TX-8001 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically testing for dead and applying earths. SG-8000 (station switchgear) is in service for station HV distribution. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 26 May 2014 a hazard report was recorded on SG-8000 and TX-8001 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during start-up after maintenance; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
